qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M8 hex screws when connecting the transmission to the engine?
What size are the largest hex screws used for transmission to engine mounting and what is their torque value?
qa_pairs.answer: M12 hex screws with a torque specification of 74 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M10 Torx bolts?
Which section of the manual covers these transmission torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23-1 Manual Transmission, specifically 23 00 Transmission in general, subsection 1AZ Transmission to engine

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque specification between M8 hex screws and M8 Torx bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 hex screws require 25 Nm while M8 Torx bolts require 22 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What types of fasteners are specified for transmission to engine mounting?
What is the torque specification for the largest Torx bolts listed?
How many different hex screw sizes are specified for transmission to engine mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: Three sizes: M8, M10, and M12
